collection.title: Audi S8 1996 to 2002 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit an Audi S8 1996 - 2002 model which requires a 22" wiper blade for the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Hook Fitting arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
